title: CoinBuddy 1.4.0 (beta)
notes: Buy and sell crypto with Mobile Money in Ghana. This build tightens permissions: no microphone, storage, media or overlay access, and Android backup is off.

title: HomeScout 1.0.0 (test build)
notes: Browse verified rental homes across Ghana and message owners directly. Plans are shown as status only in the app; subscriptions are handled on the web.

title: Whisper 0.1.0, build 6 (test build)
notes:
A calm Telegram client. This build adds Settings and Edit Profile, appearance options, rich text, polls, in-chat search and more reliable storage.

Unofficial app built on the Telegram API. Not affiliated with Telegram.
